## Rationale

Cage is completely confounded with treatment (2 cages per group, 5 mice per cage), so pairwise PERMANOVA on raw compositions at Day 0 shows significant group separation before any injection. To disentangle treatment effects from cage effects, we use two approaches that make each mouse its own control.

**Analysis 1** computes the Bray-Curtis distance between each mouse's Day 0 sample and its subsequent timepoints. This scalar measure of "how much did this mouse's microbiome change?" is then compared across groups.

**Analysis 3** subtracts each mouse's Day 0 CLR profile from its later timepoints, producing a vector of genus-level shifts. Ordinating these delta-CLR vectors with PCoA (Euclidean distance on CLR = Aitchison distance) shows whether the *direction* of change differs by treatment, independent of starting composition.

## Load libraries and data

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(vegan)
library(ggsignif)
```

```{r load-data}
zotu_raw <- read_csv("../input/zotu.csv")
tax <- read_csv("../ref/tax.csv") %>% select(OTU, domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus)

meta <- readxl::read_xlsx("../ref/MO_Metadata.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>%
  mutate(seqid = gsub("\\.", "-", Sample)) %>%
  select(seqid, Mouse, "Day" = "Day...2", "Vaccine Administered", Cage)

dat <- read_csv("../input/20260527_MO_EcoliVax.csv")
sample_ids <- dat %>% select(seqid, Mouse, Day, `Vaccine Administered`) %>% distinct()
sample_ids <- sample_ids %>%
  left_join(meta %>% select(Mouse, Cage) %>% distinct(), by = "Mouse")

# Wide count matrix
wide <- zotu_raw %>% filter(seqid %in% sample_ids$seqid) %>% column_to_rownames("seqid")
wide <- wide[sample_ids$seqid, ]

# Collapse to genus level
otu_to_genus <- tax %>% select(OTU, genus) %>% deframe()
colnames_genus <- sapply(colnames(wide), function(o) {
  g <- otu_to_genus[o]
  if (is.na(g)) "Unclassified" else g
})
wide_genus <- t(rowsum(t(wide), group = colnames_genus))
wide_genus_rel <- sweep(wide_genus, 1, rowSums(wide_genus), "/")

vax_order <- c("RBC-PLGA", "WT EC-PLGA", "-lpxM EC-PLGA")
vax_colors <- c("RBC-PLGA" = "#636363", "WT EC-PLGA" = "#e6550d", "-lpxM EC-PLGA" = "#3182bd")

sample_ids <- sample_ids %>%
  mutate(
    Day = as.integer(Day),
    Mouse = as.factor(Mouse),
    Cage = as.factor(Cage),
    `Vaccine Administered` = factor(`Vaccine Administered`, levels = vax_order)
  )
```

## Analysis 1: Within-subject Bray-Curtis distance from Day 0

```{r bc-from-baseline}
# Get Day 0 sample for each mouse
d0_map <- sample_ids %>% filter(Day == 0) %>% select(Mouse, seqid) %>% deframe()

bc_from_baseline <- sample_ids %>%
  filter(Day > 0, Mouse %in% names(d0_map)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    bc_from_d0 = vegan::vegdist(
      rbind(wide_genus_rel[seqid, ], wide_genus_rel[d0_map[as.character(Mouse)], ]),
      method = "bray"
    )[1]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### Line graph: BC distance from baseline over time

```{r Q3-bc-line, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
summary_bc <- bc_from_baseline %>%
  group_by(`Vaccine Administered`, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_bc = mean(bc_from_d0),
    sem_bc = sd(bc_from_d0) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_bc_line <- ggplot(summary_bc, aes(x = Day, y = mean_bc, color = `Vaccine Administered`)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_bc - sem_bc, ymax = mean_bc + sem_bc), width = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0, 21), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = max(summary_bc$mean_bc + summary_bc$sem_bc) * 1.05,
           label = "Injection 1", fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 24, y = max(summary_bc$mean_bc + summary_bc$sem_bc) * 1.05,
           label = "Injection 2", fontface = "italic", size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = vax_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Bray-Curtis Distance from Day 0",
       title = "Within-Subject Microbiome Shift from Baseline",
       color = "Vaccine Group") +
  theme_cowplot()

p_bc_line
ggsave("../figs/Q3_bc_from_baseline_line.png", p_bc_line, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

### Box plots: BC distance from baseline at each timepoint

```{r Q3-bc-boxplots, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
p_bc_box <- ggplot(bc_from_baseline, aes(x = `Vaccine Administered`, y = bc_from_d0,
                                          fill = `Vaccine Administered`)) +
  #geom_errorbar(stat = "summary", fun.data = mean_se, width = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = `Vaccine Administered`), height = 0, width = 0.15,
              size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("RBC-PLGA", "WT EC-PLGA"),
                                  c("RBC-PLGA", "-lpxM EC-PLGA")),
              test = "wilcox.test", map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 3,
              step_increase = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~Day, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(Day = function(x) paste("Day", x))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = vax_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = vax_colors) +
  labs(x = "", y = "BC Distance from Day 0",
       title = "Within-Subject BC Distance from Baseline by Group") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

p_bc_box
ggsave("../figs/Q3_bc_from_baseline_boxplots.png", p_bc_box, width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = 'white')
```

lmm_bc <- lmer(bc_from_d0 ~ Day * `Vaccine Administered` + (1|Mouse), data = bc_from_baseline)

### Mann-Whitney U at each timepoint

```{r bc-mannwhitney}
bc_mw <- data.frame()

for (d in sort(unique(bc_from_baseline$Day))) {
  sub <- bc_from_baseline %>% filter(Day == d)
  rbc <- sub %>% filter(`Vaccine Administered` == "RBC-PLGA") %>% pull(bc_from_d0)
  wt <- sub %>% filter(`Vaccine Administered` == "WT EC-PLGA") %>% pull(bc_from_d0)
  lpxm <- sub %>% filter(`Vaccine Administered` == "-lpxM EC-PLGA") %>% pull(bc_from_d0)

  bc_mw <- rbind(bc_mw, data.frame(
    Day = d,
    `RBC vs WT` = round(wilcox.test(rbc, wt, exact = FALSE)$p.value, 4),
    `RBC vs dlpxM` = round(wilcox.test(rbc, lpxm, exact = FALSE)$p.value, 4),
    `WT vs dlpxM` = round(wilcox.test(wt, lpxm, exact = FALSE)$p.value, 4),
    check.names = FALSE
  ))
}

write_csv(bc_mw, "../output/Q3_bc_from_baseline_mannwhitney.csv")
knitr::kable(bc_mw, caption = "Mann-Whitney U p-values on BC distance from baseline")
```

## Analysis 3: PCoA on CLR-delta from baseline

For each mouse at each post-baseline timepoint, subtract its Day 0 CLR-transformed genus profile from the current timepoint's CLR profile. Ordinate these delta vectors using PCoA on Euclidean distance (equivalent to Aitchison distance on the compositional changes). This shows whether the direction and magnitude of compositional change differs by treatment group, independent of starting composition.

```{r clr-delta}
# CLR transform genus counts (pseudocount 0.5)
wide_genus_pseudo <- wide_genus + 0.5
log_genus <- log(wide_genus_pseudo)
geo_mean <- rowMeans(log_genus)
clr_genus <- log_genus - geo_mean

# Compute delta: each sample minus that mouse's Day 0
d0_clr_map <- clr_genus[sample_ids %>% filter(Day == 0) %>% pull(seqid), ]
rownames(d0_clr_map) <- sample_ids %>% filter(Day == 0) %>% pull(Mouse)

post_ids <- sample_ids %>% filter(Day > 0, Mouse %in% rownames(d0_clr_map))
clr_delta <- clr_genus[post_ids$seqid, ] - d0_clr_map[as.character(post_ids$Mouse), ]
rownames(clr_delta) <- post_ids$seqid
```

```{r clr-delta-pcoa, fig.width=25, fig.height=5}
delta_permanova <- data.frame()
plots <- list()

for (d in sort(unique(post_ids$Day))) {
  day_ids <- post_ids %>% filter(Day == d) %>% pull(seqid)
  day_delta <- clr_delta[day_ids, ]
  day_meta <- post_ids %>% filter(Day == d) %>% arrange(match(seqid, day_ids))

  # Euclidean distance on CLR delta = Aitchison distance on changes
  day_dist <- dist(day_delta, method = "euclidean")
  day_pcoa <- cmdscale(day_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  day_eig <- day_pcoa$eig
  day_prop <- day_eig / sum(day_eig[day_eig > 0]) * 100

  pcoa_coords <- data.frame(
    seqid = day_ids,
    PC1 = day_pcoa$points[,1],
    PC2 = day_pcoa$points[,2]
  ) %>% inner_join(day_meta, by = "seqid")

  # Pairwise PERMANOVA
  comparisons <- list(
    c("RBC-PLGA", "WT EC-PLGA"),
    c("RBC-PLGA", "-lpxM EC-PLGA"),
    c("WT EC-PLGA", "-lpxM EC-PLGA")
  )

  for (comp in comparisons) {
    idx <- day_meta$`Vaccine Administered` %in% comp
    sub_delta <- day_delta[idx, ]
    sub_grp <- day_meta$`Vaccine Administered`[idx]

    if (length(unique(sub_grp)) < 2 || nrow(sub_delta) < 4) next

    sub_dist <- dist(sub_delta, method = "euclidean")
    perm_res <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ sub_grp, permutations = 999)

    delta_permanova <- rbind(delta_permanova, data.frame(
      Day = d,
      Comparison = paste(comp[1], "vs", comp[2]),
      `pseudo-F` = round(perm_res$F[1], 4),
      p.value = perm_res$`Pr(>F)`[1],
      check.names = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot(pcoa_coords, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = `Vaccine Administered`,
                                fill = `Vaccine Administered`)) +
    stat_ellipse(geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.8, level = 0.95, type = "norm") +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = vax_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = vax_colors) +
    labs(
      x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", day_prop[1]),
      y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", day_prop[2]),
      title = paste("Day", d)
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

  plots[[as.character(d)]] <- p
}

legend <- get_legend(
  plots[["7"]] + theme(legend.position = "right") +
    guides(fill = "none") + labs(color = "Vaccine Group")
)

p_delta_pcoa <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(plotlist = plots, nrow = 1),
  legend, rel_widths = c(1, 0.1)
)

title <- ggdraw() + draw_label("PCoA on CLR-Delta from Baseline (Aitchison Distance, Per-Day)",
                                fontface = "bold", size = 14)
p_delta_pcoa <- plot_grid(title, p_delta_pcoa, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.06, 1))

p_delta_pcoa
ggsave("../figs/Q3_clr_delta_pcoa_per_day.png", p_delta_pcoa, width = 25, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
